uniform-vs-mixed.alt: Two fields of 45 plants during a fungal outbreak. In the uniform planting every plant is the same genotype, a clone, and all 45 are infected. In the mixed planting four genotypes are scattered, three of them carrying alleles that resist this fungus strain, and 5 of 45 plants are infected, all of the susceptible genotype. Caption: in the mixed field, spores often land on plants they cannot infect, so the outbreak spreads less.

sickle-malaria.alt: Three genotypes where malaria is common. HbA HbA: normal hemoglobin, severe malaria more likely, fitness high but reduced by malaria. HbA HbS carrier: little or no sickling, strong protection against severe malaria, highest fitness. HbS HbS: cells sickle when oxygen is low, sickle cell disease, low fitness without medical care. Selection removes each allele in one homozygote, so both stay common: heterozygote advantage, a form of balancing selection.
